## Introduction

As heart disease is a major health concern in Scotland, understanding the patterns of heart disease deaths across different geographical area and demographic groups can help identify health inequalities and support improvements in council area for planning healthcare and prevention strategies.

This analysis follows the Data set 'Heart Disease Mortality by Council Area' published by Public Health Scotland. The data set provides information on heart disease mortality across Scottish council areas. 

The aim of our investigation is to analyse patterns and differences in heart disease mortality across Scotland, focusing particularly on relationship between ages, sex and location. Data visualisation, data cleaning and regression model will be used to explore...
